questions.question: What was a person under the Nazirite vow forbidden to do?
options: Drink wine, cut hair, or touch the dead
Pray aloud, travel far, or eat meat
Marry, own land, or enter the camp
Speak, work, or leave his tent
questions.answer: Drink wine, cut hair, or touch the dead

questions.question: What famous blessing is given in this chapter?
options: The song of Moses and Miriam
The blessing of the twelve tribes
